$comment: Comparer findings that are known and deliberate. Each entry matches findings by kind and regular expressions on class, member and detail, and must say why. `probe` names the test/probes check that measured it, where one does; entries without one rest on the reason alone and are candidates for a probe.

entries.reason: The dictionary types withProperties as Array of Strings; it takes an object of properties, as every withProperties does.
entries.probe: methods: createPlainTextQRCode() withProperties as an object

entries.reason: Text objects have no names, so a name bound has nothing to match; the dictionary copies the generic collection signature.
entries.probe: allowlist: words.itemByRange() with name strings throws

entries.reason: Folder destinations: the dictionary types them as File; they take a Folder or a path string.
entries.probe: methods: packageForPrint() to a Folder / path string; allowlist: generateIDMLSchema() to a Folder

entries.reason: The dictionary lists Boolean for an index parameter, a dictionary error.
Movie and Sound inherit PageItem.duplicate(to, by); the dictionary lists a parameterless override.
SVGs.add takes the page-item add(layer, at, reference, withProperties); the dictionary lists withProperties only.

entries.detail: declared \(at, reference, withProperties\); dictionary \(to, reference, withProperties\)
entries.reason: Same parameters; upstream names the first one `at` instead of the dictionary's `to`.
entries.probe: styles-and-params: tables.add() first parameter is `to`, a LocationOptions

entries.detail: declared Folder; dictionary also allows File$
entries.reason: Folder-valued: the dictionary says File; InDesign returns a Folder.

entries.reason: Folder-valued: the dictionary says File; the setter takes a Folder or a path.
entries.probe: quirks: GeneralPreference.temporaryFolder reads a Folder / takes the Folder back / takes a path string

entries.reason: The dictionary lists the PageItems collection as a cell's contents; a graphic cell reads back its page item (a Rectangle), which is declared.

entries.reason: Upstream declares NumberingStyle; the value read back (ARABIC) exists in both enumerations.

entries.reason: Read-only while clippingType is NONE (the fixture's state), writable once a clipping path applies. State, not type.
entries.probe: allowlist: ClippingPathSettings writable with / read-only without a clipping path

entries.reason: Engine internals reflection exposes (__120__, __usdst__); not API.
